purpose: Teach: 東日本/東亜/堺/生き残り/脳裏/紡/転生/テクスト

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、東日本大震災の社会学研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: Sakura, you wrote your paper on the sociology of the Great East Japan Earthquake, didn't you?
lines.style: Warm, interested opening. Clear enunciation. Steady, encouraging pace. Slight upturn at the end—checking in, not testing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦前の東亜経済圏構想の歴史研究を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote mine on the history of pre-war East Asian economic planning.
lines.style: Measured, earnest. Meets her eyes. Spoken with quiet conviction but no defensiveness. Confident without needing to prove anything.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 堺市の戦国時代の自治史を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And you covered the autonomous history of Sakai during the Sengoku period in your work, didn't you?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely curious. Slight pause before the question. Warm but observational—she's tracking something beneath the surface.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、戦時下の生き残りの民俗誌を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I focused on folk ethnography of survival during wartime.
lines.style: Direct, grounded. No hesitation. Brief but complete. Speaks as though this is solid ground she's already walked.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦争体験の脳裏に焼き付く記憶の研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: You also examined research on war memories—the kind that sear themselves into the mind, didn't you?
lines.style: Gently leading. Thoughtful pause. Not lecturing. Voice carries respect for the weight of the subject matter. Careful precision.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、絹を紡ぐ、つまり紡糸の伝統技法を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I wrote about traditional silk-spinning techniques—the craft of sericulture itself.
lines.style: Clear statement. Slight firmness on the core word. Speaks with the precision of someone defining a technical subject. No apology in her tone.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 輪廻転生の哲学的研究を論文で扱いましたね
lines.en: And the philosophical research on transmigration of souls—you covered that as well?
lines.style: Reflective, measured. Voice carries the philosophical weight lightly. Genuine curiosity underneath. A small smile in the tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい、文学テクスト、つまり原典の解釈論を論文で扱いました
lines.en: Yes, I examined the hermeneutics of literary texts—the interpretation of original sources.
lines.style: Assured close. Calm, authoritative without coldness. Full presence. Ends cleanly, as though she's stated something foundational.
